🚀 Transforming Ideas into Digital Experiences | 
💻 Software Engineer | 📈 Digital Marketer | 🌟 Brand Builder |
🏅 Recognized by @exchange4media & @adgully |
🌐 Empowering Savings
profile.summary:
Hello! I'm Raj Patel, a passionate Software Engineer, Digital Marketer, and Brand Builder dedicated to transforming ideas into impactful digital experiences. My journey in technology began with a fascination for how code can create powerful, user-friendly applications. Over the years, I've honed my skills across various domains, ultimately leading me to found SnapBuy, India.

My entrepreneurial journey started with a simple yet ambitious goal: to help users save money while shopping online. I launched SnapBuy, an innovative E-commerce platform, initially developed with basic web technologies. Today, SnapBuy thrives on modern frameworks, serving over 20,000 satisfied customers and partnering with more than 80 leading brands.

In the early days, I wore many hats, from coding to marketing, to ensure SnapBuy's success. Our effective marketing strategies have resulted in over INR 7,00,000+ Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV), and our brand campaigns have received recognition from industry giants like exchange4media and adgully.

Before SnapBuy, I contributed to Kemsys Technologies, where I worked on cutting-edge systems for managing, monitoring, and controlling IoT assets. I had the privilege of working with esteemed clients like Kirloskar, Rogers, Indygo, and Sasken. I developed intuitive user interfaces that ensured seamless interactions and enhanced user experiences.

I am always excited to connect with fellow professionals and explore new opportunities in software development, digital marketing, and brand building. Let’s connect and collaborate to create exceptional digital experiences and drive success in the digital age.
